products.title: Killian Rolling in Love Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rolling in Love by By Kilian is a women's and men's Oriental Floral fragrance. Rolling in Love was released in 2019. The nose of this perfume is Pascal Gaurin. The top notes are Almond Milk and Ambrette (Musk Mallow); middle notes are Iris, Freesia, Heliotrope, Raspberry, Hedione, and Peony; and the bottom note is Vanilla, Tuberose, Tonka Bean, Musk, Lactones and Caramel.

products.title: Amouage Guidance 46 Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Amouage Guidance 46 Extrait de Parfum is a creamy, deep and very luxurious unisex perfume. This fragrance feels smooth, warm and comforting with a strong artistic touch. It opens soft and slightly sweet, then slowly turns creamy, floral and woody. Amouage Guidance 46 Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2024 and the extract concentration makes it intense, long lasting and very elegant on the skin.

products.title: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum is a modern, masculine scent. Prada Luna Rossa Ocean Eau de Parfum was released in 2023. It carries a creamy, woody amber style with a fresh citrus opening of grapefruit, a deep heart of woody notes and frankincense, and a warm base of vanilla and amber xtreme.

products.title: Lattafa Angham Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Angham Eau de Parfum is a women's and men's Oriental Vanilla perfume. This is a new fragrance. Angham was launched in 2024. Ginger, Mandarin and Pink Pepper, Lavender, Praline, Cacao, Jasmine, Vanilla, Amber and Musk are the top, middle, and base notes, respectively. It is a pleasant, warm and a little spicy aroma which is gentle, creamy and prolonged to the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Mazaaji Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Mazaaji, by Lattafa Perfumes, is a floral female fragrance product. It starts with Orange blossoms and mandarin orange notes placed on top, making it fresh and slightly sweet at the beginning. Bulgarian rose, Turkish rose and jasmine are used as the middle notes and provide the heart of the floral richness and the romanticism. Patchouli, vanilla, amber and sandalwood are the base notes; they add warmth, softness and protracted sweetness to the odour.

products.title: Burberry Hero Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Hero Parfum is a heavy and cosy men's fragrance that is intense, woody and contemporary. The perfume opens with a calm and soft mix of amyris that brings about a peaceful and tranquil introduction of wood. The middle part brings in the rich cedarwood that brings out the pungent scent of a strong, masculine matter. There is a base layer that consists of cypriol oil, giving it a long-lasting dry earthy smell that lingers on the skin all day. This is a confident, powerful, and manly perfume that is suitable for men who prefer woody fragrances.

products.title: Burberry Mr Burberry Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Mr Burberry Eau de Parfum is a deep, warm and classy men's perfume that is strong and contemporary. It begins with new tones of fresh cardamom, mint, and grapefruit, which provide a spic,y clean beginning. Gradually, lavender and nutmeg create a soothing and mellowing touch. The scent is rich and long-term because of the foundation of patchouli, amber, and woods. This perfume is manly, assertive and suitable for men who enjoy a bold yet classy smell.

products.title: Calvin Klein One Gold Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein One Gold Eau de Toilette is a modern unisex fragrance that has a fresh and smooth nature. The fragrance opens with a light introduction that is a mix of clean fig and bergamot, and fruits. The scent evolves into gentle floral tones, which comprise jasmine and neroli in order to produce a calming and relaxing effect. The Woody notes also give a warm depth, but at the same time, never leaves the skin. This perfume has a clean look that gives an appearance of elegance, as well as serves as an appropriate everyday perfume.

products.title: Riiffs Goodness Oud Purple Wave Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Goodness Oud Purple Wave Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex scent from Riiffs Perfumes. It opens fresh and creamy with saffron, rose and lemon, which feels bright and slightly spicy at the start. The middle brings soft floral jasmine sambac, mixed with smooth ambroxan, for a clean, warm feel. Base notes of tonka bean, amber and vanilla add sweet warmth and depth, making the scent feel cozy, creamy and long lasting for daily wear or special outings.

products.title: Kayali Utopia Vanilla Coco 21 Eau De Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Kayali Utopia Vanilla Coco 21 Eau De Parfum Intense is an Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. It was launched in 2021. The nose behind this fragrance is Gabriela Chelariu. Top notes are Coconut Milk, Honeysuckle, Pear Blossom and Italian Lemon; middle notes are Tuberose, Jasmine Sambac, Gardenia and Ambrette; base notes are Bourbon Vanilla, Sandalwood, Musk and Patchouli.

products.title: Creed Royal Princes Oud Eau de Parfum (2024)
products.body_html: Creed Royal Princess Oud Eau de Parfum is a gentle, luxurious fragrance that is created by women who desire to represent royalty. The perfume opens in a light, flowery, fresh and blends violet, rose and bergamot to give the light, smooth fragrance. The aroma becomes a warm, creamy smell that has jasmine, iris, patchouli and a faint quantity of vanilla sweetness. The smell of the perfume is oud mixed with sandalwood and styrax, that give it a woody aroma that stays several hours on the body of the person. There is a class,y feminine smell in the perfume that is luxurious.

products.title: Ramon Monegal Mon Patchouli Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ramon Monegal Mon Patchouli Eau de Parfum is a creamy, unisex scent that highlights the deep character of patchouli. Created by perfumer Ramon Monegal, this fragrance focuses on natural Indonesian patchouli leaf blended with warm amber, soft florals and resin tones. The mix feels earthy, woody and slightly sweet at once, giving a classic niche perfume vibe.

products.title: Rayhaan Ellwood Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Ellwood Eau de Parfum is a bold, fresh woody fragrance for men who like strong, natural style scents. It opens with bright Italian bergamot that feels fresh and clean. The middle brings cypress and davana with a green woody feel, giving it depth and energy. The base is warm and earthy, with patchouli and Virginia cedarwood that create a powerful, masculine trail.

products.title: Rayhaan Wood Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Wood Noir Eau de Parfum is a dark, woody scent for men who like warm, spicy, smooth perfumes. It opens with spicy cardamom and sharp Sichuan pepper, which gives a fresh heat at the start. The heart features creamy woods like sandalwood, oud and vetiver, which give the scent depth and class. In drydown, creamy tonka bean, amber and vanilla mix together and create a soft, sweet, warm trail.

products.title: Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum is a bold, masculine scent. Rayhaan Corium Eau de Parfum was released in 2023 and carries a dark, warm profile built around chestnut, spices and elemi in the opening; aromatic sage in the middle and a deep base of vanilla, leather and oud. The mixture feels creamy, slightly sweet and smoky with a strong leather tone that gives a classy yet powerful vibe.

products.title: Rayhaan Cordova Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Cordova Eau de Parfum is a bold and smooth men’s fragrance. Rayhaan Cordova Eau de Parfum was launched in 2023. It carries a strong leather woody scent profile built with leather (top note), patchouli and cypress (middle notes) and amber, woody notes and vetiver (base notes).

products.title: Rayhaan Imperia Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Imperia Eau de Parfum is a fresh, woody aromatic men’s perfume for those who like clean yet bold fragrances. It opens with a lively mix of bergamot, apple, mint and elemi, offering a fresh, slightly sweet start. The middle notes of patchouli, jasmine, rose and sandalwood add a soft, woody, floral touch. In the dry down, cedar, oakmoss, amber and musk blend smoothly to create a warm, masculine base that feels classy and long lasting.

products.title: Rayhaan Tiger Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Tiger Eau de Parfum is a bold, woody, spicy perfume for men who like strong yet smooth perfumes. It opens with a warm, spicy blend of nutmeg, clove and lemon that feels fresh yet deep. The middle has a soft, creamy touch of milk blended with rose and davana, offering a slightly sweet, smooth texture. The base settles into creamy notes of amber, patchouli, frankincense and labdanum that feel warm, resinous and long lasting.

products.title: Rayhaan Lion Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Lion Eau de Parfum is a bold, fresh, spicy aromatic perfume for men who like strong yet smooth perfumes. Released in 2024, it opens with a fresh mix of lavender, pear, mint and bergamot, which feels clean and slightly sweet. The heart comes with warm spices like cinnamon and cumin blended with herbal clary sage. The base dries down to a creamy, cozy blend of vanilla, amber, cedar and patchouli, giving a masculine, confident vibe.

products.title: Rayhaan Ocean Rush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Ocean Rush Eau de Parfum is a fresh, aquatic style scent for men who like clean, energetic fragrances. Launched in 2024, it opens with a splash of watery, citrus notes like cascalone, bergamot, aquozone and mandarin that feel bright and breezy. The heart features herbal notes of lavender, cypress and rosemary, giving it a green aromatic feel. The dry down settles into warm amber, musk and patchouli, giving smooth, masculine depth.

products.title: Rayhaan Pacific Aqua Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Pacific Aqua Eau de Parfum is a fresh and clean men’s fragrance. Launched in 2022, it is a bright aquatic style scent built around citrus and aromatic notes. The opening feels crisp and lively with bergamot, lemon, tangerine and cardamom. The middle brings soft herbal freshness from lavender and cypress. The base of Rayhaan Pacific Aqua Eau de Parfum settles into warm amber, giving the scent a smooth finish.

products.title: Paris Corner Rifaaqat Adorn Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Rifaaqat Adorn Eau de Parfum is a smooth, modern unisex scent. It was released in 2024 and begins with a new spicy and citrus blend of pink pepper, coriander, mandarin and violet that is bright and a little sweet. The middle is a woody, earthy touch of patchouli, cedar and oakmoss, which gives it depth and richness. The base settles into warm ambergris, benzoin and vanilla, and the drydown is soft and creamy, elegant, but easy to wear every day.

products.title: Paris Corner Molten Caramel Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Molten Caramel Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy, unisex perfume from Paris Corner fragrances. Launched in 2025, it is a dessert style scent profile built around soft gourmand accords of white chocolate, caramel and milk blended with warm sugary notes of brown sugar, vanilla and praline. The scent opens smooth and milky, sweet, then slowly melts into a cozy sugary base that feels warm, tasty and comforting on the skin.

products.title: Paris Corner Marshmallow Blush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Marshmallow Blush Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet, unisex perfume. Launched in 2025, Paris Corner Marshmallow Blush Eau de Parfum is a playful and creamy scent profile made with fruity top notes of strawberry, raspberry and lemon; smooth heart notes of ambroxan and orange blossom and a fluffy sugary base of marshmallow and musk.

products.title: Paris Corner Choco Cult Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Choco Cult Eau de Parfum is a creamy, sweet, unisex perfume made for people who love dessert like scents. It opens with creamy caramel mixed with fresh orange and bergamot, giving a soft, sweet citrus start. The middle is a full chocolate fantasy with cocoa, coconut, butter, peach and blackcurrant notes that feel smooth, tasty and cozy. The base dries down into warm vanilla, sandalwood and musk, making the scent comforting, creamy and addictive with a soft gourmand trail.

products.title: Fragrance World Urban Man Le Parfum
products.body_html: Fragrance World Urban Man Le Parfum is a good, smooth and elegant men's perfume that is designed to be used in the city. It begins with a spicy taste of cardamom, which is daring and slightly hot with the initial spray. After a while, soft lavender and iris enter the scene and give the smell a clean, calm, and sophisticated scent. The overall scent is masculine and highly sophisticated, which suits men who prefer the modern and confident perfumes that are not loud enough to be detected.

products.title: Fragrance World Urban Man Paradise Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fragrance world Urban Man Paradise Eau de Parfum is a new and contemporary male fragrance, which appears to be daring and assertive. It begins with a very fresh puff of citrus and green that are refreshing and invigorating, and proceeds to a warm and spicy core that makes it rich and nuanced. The foundation of soft woods provides a durable soft touch that takes a long time to leave the skin. This fragrance is ideal to men who prefer fresh, contemporary, and confident smells and can be worn during the day as well as nat ight.

products.title: Fragrance World Urban Man Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fragrance World Urban Man Elixir Eau de Parfum is a modern men's fragrance which is fresh, spicy and woody simultaneously. It begins with a clear combination of bergamot, jasmine and pink pepper, which is light and sleek. Lavender and saffron gradually emerge and introduce a fancy, masculine touch. Amber, patchouli, and cedar are all warm and woody and will be lingering hours upon skin in the dry down. This perfume is assertive, classy, and can be worn both in the daytime and at night.

products.title: French Avenue Essence de Blanc Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Essence de Blanc Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and airy unisex fragrance made for daily wear. It was launched in 2022 and opens with bright citrus and green notes that feel light and refreshing from the first spray. As it settles, soft, spicy and minty tones come forward, giving a calm and cooling feel. The base is smooth and slightly aquatic with ambergris and soft floral notes, making the scent feel modern, new and easy to wear.

products.title: French Avenue Vulcan Feu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Vulcan Feu Eau de Parfum is a fresh, sweet and somewhat spicy perfume that suits both the women and men. It starts with an appetising blend of mango and lemon that is refreshing and cheerful, and it is spiced a little by ginger. Tones become light and sweet as it subsides with floral notes of praline such as jasmine and violet. Tonka bean, woods and moss make the base warm and smooth and thus comfortable and lasting. This smell is contemporary, comfortable, and very satisfying.

products.title: French Avenue Pinnace White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Pinnace White Eau de Parfum from French Avenue Fragrances is a fresh, bright and easy to wear perfume for women who enjoy clean, fruity scents. This perfume was introduced in 2024 and starts with sticky sweet citrus that is fresh and joyful. The heart adds a soft green, fruity touch, while the base settles into a smooth, musky finish. French Avenue Pinnace White Eau de Parfum feels light, modern and perfect for daily wear without being heavy or loud.

products.title: French Avenue Paradox Tribute Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Paradox Tribute Eau de Parfum is a rich and bold unisex scent. Paradox Tribute Eau de Parfum was launched in 2021. It opens with juicy plum mixed with a soft spicy touch of pink pepper and fresh Italian lemon. The middle feels smooth and comforting with Turkish rose, cinnamon and a light chocolate note that gives a creamy feel. The base is dark and strong with tobacco, patchouli and labdanum, which stays long on skin and feels classy and confident.

products.title: Fragrance World Varakh Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fragrance World Varakh Gold Eau de Parfum is a luxurious and dignified perfume targeted at women who enjoy heavy and sophisticated aromas. It starts with a spicy bite of saffron and black pepper blended with fresh bergamot, and it is bold as one sprays the perfume. Gradually the odour turns warm and silky, including iris, balsam and soft woods. Its foundation is solid and lavishly oud, leather, patchouli, and sandalwood, with a long-lasting and superior touch

products.title: French Avenue Fierte Luna Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Fierte Luna Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume made for people who enjoy sweet citrus scents with a warm touch. It opens fresh and clean with lavender, bergamot and lemon, which feels bright and uplifting from the first spray. In the middle, the scent becomes soft and cozy with honey, cinnamon, jasmine and cashmeran, giving it a slightly sweet, creamy feel. The base is warm and addictive with vanilla, tobacco leaf and tonka bean.

products.title: French Avenue Sweet Paradise Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Sweet Paradise Eau de Parfum is a light and cheerful perfume targeted at women who will appreciate sweet and fresh perfumes. It has a light fruity sensation in the beginning, with the mixture of mandarin and clear musk that is very smooth. Soft flowers and peach make the heart feel creamy and soft. The foundation is cosy and sweet with tonka and heliotrope, so the smell is very soothing and permanent. Worn all the time and on special occasions.

products.title: French Avenue Chocola Addict Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Chocola Addict Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance with a rich chocolate feel. Launched in 2025, this scent is warm, sweet and a little dark in nature. It opens with creamy chocolate mixed with fresh tangerine and soft amber, which gives a sweet yet smooth start. The middle note feels bold with leather and smoky incense, adding depth and character. Overall, French Avenue Chocola Addict Eau de Parfum is cozy, addictive and perfect for people who love chocolate based perfumes with a slightly bold touch.

products.title: French Avenue Pinnace Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Pinnace Noir Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance with a fresh, fruity and slightly spicy feel. It was introduced in 2024 and opens bright and juicy with apple and citrus notes that feel clean and energetic. As it settles, warm spices and soft florals come out, giving it depth and character. The base is smooth and creamy with vanilla and woods, making it comforting and classy at the same time.

products.title: French Avenue Meringue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Meringue Eau de Parfum is a soft, creamy and modern women’s perfume for those who love sweet but balanced scents. It opens fresh and juicy with pineapple, mandarin and bergamot that feel bright and happy. Slowly, it turns smooth and cozy with suede and sandalwood at its middle notes. The base is warm and comforting with vanilla, white musk, birch and ambergris, giving it a clean yet slightly woody finish.

products.title: French Avenue Luscious Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Luscious Eau de Parfum is a sweet, warm and tasty smelling fragrance made specially for women who love wealthy gourmand scents. It opens with a creamy, nutty feel mixed with fresh spice, which feels soft but very catchy. As it settles, the perfume becomes cozier and sweeter with edible notes that feel comforting and addictive. The base is warm, smooth and slightly musky, making the scent long lasting and pleasing on the skin. French Avenue Luscious Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who enjoy sweet but balanced perfumes that are not too sharp or loud.

products.title: French Avenue Irida Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Irida Extrait de Parfum is a unisex perfume, which is warm, sweet, and spicy in scent. French Avenue released this perfume in 2024, and it is created to be liked by those who appreciate both strong and smooth odours. It begins with a fat cherry that is intertwined with a light ginger touch, followed by the soft jasmine. The foundation is comfortable and warm, which makes it ideal to wear it daily and for evening use.

products.title: French Avenue Fierte Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Fierté Eau de Parfum is a bold, warm women’s perfume for those who love deep, spicy and slightly sweet scents. Launched in 2024, this perfume opens with a smoky mix of incense, tobacco and saffron, which feels creamy and confident from the first spray. As it settles, spicy notes mix with elemi and dry cedarwood, giving it a smooth, classy feel. The base is soft and comforting with vanilla, benzoin and tonka, leaving a long lasting, cozy trail that feels elegant and strong at the same time.

products.title: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Azzure Aoud Eau de Parfum is a strong and dominant perfume for men with warm, fruity, and deep notes. The introduction is a pleasant fruity mix that is infused with rose and saffron to produce a smooth but slightly spicy taste. The robust oud evolves over time with patchouli and benzoin in order to establish a complex, dark atmosphere. The bottom part of the combines leather and wood materials with soft fabrics and creates a long-lasting and powerful smell that comprises vanilla and amber.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir Parfum
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir Parfum is a deep, elegant men’s fragrance from the designer house of Narciso Rodriguez. Released in 2022, it is a smooth woody musk scent with a modern dark twist. The scent opens fresh and spicy with cardamom, citrus and cypress, then moves into a soft heart of iris, musk and suede. The base is creamy and warm with sandalwood, leather, vetiver and tonka bean, giving it a clean yet sensual masculine feel that works all year.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Moscow Mule Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Moscow Mule Eau de Parfum is a citrus aromatic perfume for both women and men. Moscow Mule was launched in 2017. The nose of Romano Ricci backs this perfume. It starts on new notes of Bergamot, Lime, and Lemon. Ginger, Hedione, and Apple are added to the heart, giving the heart a spicy and slightly fruity touch. It is drying down to White Musk, Woody Notes, Ambrette, and Amberwood and has a clean and smooth finish to it.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Not a Perfume Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Not a Perfume Eau de Parfum is a soft and non-polluting perfume for women. This fragrance was introduced in 2010 and was produced by Romano Ricci using only one note, which is Cetalox. It is light, musky, and a little woody with a refreshing feel on the skin. It is incorporated with your natural perfume and is a casual, contemporary, and comfortable daily wear.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun MMMM.... Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun MMMM.... Eau de Parfum is a women's / men's perfume. MMMM.... was released in 2016. The major notes include Raspberry, Geranium and Neroli; Tuberose, Iris, Jasmine Sambac and Orange Blossom. Vanilla, Caramel, Sandalwood, Heliotrope, White Musk and Patchouli are the base notes. It starts with a luscious raspberry which is delightful and light-hearted and gradually changes to the mild floral core of white. Drying out, there is a blend of vanilla and caramel with sandalwood and musk, making it warm, smooth and cosy and hard to forget, lasting the hours.

products.title: Riiffs Goodness Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Goodness Oud Eau de Parfum is a bold, deep oriental woody perfume for men who like a strong presence. It opens with spicy, fresh notes of pink pepper, clary sage and saffron. The middle brings smooth ambroxan and dry cedar wood, which gives it a clean woody feel. The base is warm and long lasting with white musk, patchouli, amber and guaiac wood.

products.title: Lattafa Mashmoom Attar Perfume Oil
products.body_html: Attar Mashmoom by Lattafa Perfumes is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Attar Mashmoom was launched in 2025. Top notes are Rose and Bergamot; middle notes are Caramel and Peony; base notes are Musk and Vanilla.

products.title: Lattafa Yara Tous Attar Perfume Oil
products.body_html: Experience the elegance of Lattafa Yara Tous Concentrated Perfume Oil, a refined attar crafted for women. This 20ml bottle delivers a long-lasting, rich fragrance that enhances your presence with subtle sophistication. Perfect for those who appreciate a concentrated scent that lingers gracefully throughout the day.

products.title: Lattafa Yara Candy Attar Perfume Oil
products.body_html: Lattafa Yara Candy Concentrated Perfume Oil is an exquisite attar designed for women who value refined and enduring fragrances. This 20ml bottle offers a sophisticated blend that unfolds gracefully, leaving a subtle yet captivating scent throughout the day. Ideal for those who desire a luxurious and intimate aroma, it enhances your presence with elegance and charm, perfect for both everyday wear and special moments.

products.title: Lattafa Yara Moi Attar Perfume Oil
products.body_html: Lattafa Yara Moi Attar Perfume Oil is a sweet, creamy and soft perfume oil that is designed by confident women. It is inspired by Perfect Intense by Marc Jacobs and provides a rich, warm, feminine touch. The smell begins to be fruity and a little sweet, and then creamy and floral. During the dry down, warm vanilla and smooth musk remain on the skin over a long period of time. It is an oily concentrate and thus a minute amount is sufficient and lasts a long time.

products.title: Lattafa Esraa Attar Perfume Oil
products.body_html: Attar Esraa by Lattafa Perfumes is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Attar Esraa was launched in 2025. Top notes are Blackcurrant, Lychee and Apple; middle notes are Rose, Red Fruits and Raspberry; base notes are Musk, Caramel and Vanilla.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Nyla Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Nyla Eau de Parfum is an elegant, soft, and floral perfume intended for women who are fond of fresh and sweet fragrances. It starts with a delightful blend of coconut, peach, bergamot, and mandarin which is very uplifting and cheerful. The middle note consists of tiare, white flowers, jasmine, and rose that impart a velvety floral note. The long-lasting background of white musk and patchouli is warm and pure on the skin.

products.title: Otoori Oud Al Saqr Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Otoori Oud Al Saqr Blue Eau de Parfum is a decadent, elegant unisex scent crafted from a smooth mixture of floral, woody and sweet notes. It opens fresh and soft, then slowly warms and deepens on the skin. The blend of iris, rose, cedarwood, orange blossom and tonka creates a balanced scent that feels elegant yet not too heavy. It’s a scent that leaves a nice impression when you walk by, a simple yet royal style fragrance.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Habib Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Habib Eau de Parfum is a fresh yet warm perfume made for men who like classy and bold scents. Introduced in 2025, Habib starts with a clean and fresh mixture of lavender, bergamot and mint that is quite smooth and soothing. The middle has a nice touch of pineapple combined with amber and soft benzoin, which gives a rich and slightly creamy feel. The tonka bean, vanilla and musk at the base keep it warm and comforting and the scent lasts long and attractive.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Lutfah The Seventh Heaven Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Lutfah The Seventh Heaven Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, this fragrance feels rich, warm and slightly spicy with a deep Arabic touch. It opens with a fresh spicy mix of pink pepper, bright Sicilian bergamot and sweet davana that feels uplifting and classy. The heart is warm and resinous with white amber, agarwood and herbal rosemary, giving a calm but powerful feel. The base is deep and long lasting with leather, earthy Haitian vetiver, and soft musk that stays on skin for hours and feels luxurious.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Lutfah Light in the Heart Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Lutfah Light in the Heart Eau de Parfum is a warm and modern oriental woody perfume made for men who like soft spice and smooth woods. It opens with a fresh but spicy feel and slowly turns creamy and cozy on the skin. The combination feels classy but still easy to wear, not too loud and not too sharp.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Luthfah First Love Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Luthfaf First Love Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and romantic fragrance made for women who love gentle yet addictive scents. It opens with a fresh fruity touch of lemon, peach and cassis mixed with green cypress, giving a bright and cheerful start. The heart is floral and creamy with jasmine, ylang ylang, violet and milky lactones that feel smooth and comforting. As it settles, it becomes warm and cozy with vanilla, caramel, heliotrope and musk. The base feels sweet, powdery and slightly creamy, perfect for daily wear and special moments.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Uhud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Uhud Eau de Parfum, the vanilla fragrance that is sweet and warm, is created for men and women alike. The perfume starts with a powerful combination of caramel and red fruits along with a delicate rose note that is sweet and enticing. The honey, tonka, and raspberry slowly come forward and turn the scent into a creamy and smooth one. In the base, vanilla, white musk, and amber linger on the skin for a long time and feel warm and sophisticated.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Safa Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Safa Perfume is an easy-going, a bit romantic, and modern ladies' scent that gives off the impression of being both refreshing and warm simultaneously. The first note to reveal itself is the almost intoxicating mixture of juicy lychee and red fruits along with a barely perceptible touch of nuttiness, which is all very cheerful and silky. With the time passing, one can feel the soft floral notes of rose and magnolia on the skin, and they are nothing but classy. The dry-down is a lovely combination of vanilla and gourmand notes that create a feel of warmth and creaminess, which is so comforting that it lingers for many hours.

products.title: Riiffs Fleurie Violette Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Fleurie Violette Eau de Parfum is a soft, feminine scent for women who like gentle floral perfumes. It opens with fresh rose and white flowers mixed with a light woody touch of cashmere wood. After a few minutes, it turns creamy and sweet with vanilla bean and coconut notes that feel smooth and comforting. The dry down is warm and cozy, with tonka bean, amber and musk that stay on skin nicely and leave a soft, elegant trail.

products.title: Riiffs Fleurie Emerald Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Fleurie Emerald Eau de Parfum is a sweet and elegant women's perfume. Launched in 2025, it features a creamy, oriental vanilla scent profile made from juicy blood orange, lemon peel and lavender (top notes); soft white flowers, licorice, cinnamon and anise (middle notes) and creamy caramel, vanilla bean and musk (base notes). All notes blend harmoniously to create a smooth, warm, slightly sweet fragrance that feels classy yet still playful and modern.

products.title: Riiffs Ultimatum Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Ultimatum Extrait De Parfum Women's bold and classy perfume that emphasises your self-confidence. Its rich and full day-long scent makes one feel graceful and radiant. This extrait de parfum comes in a very elegant 100ml bottle and is ideal to leave a very strong and memorable impression on every woman.

products.title: Riiffs Areebah Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Areebah Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume from the house of Riiffs Perfumes. It is a creamy, oriental, woody scent that feels warm, sweet and a little exotic at the same time. The scent opens with fruity and spicy tones of tropical fruits, osmanthus and saffron. The middle notes include patchouli, frangipani and agarwood, which impart a creamy, woody feel. In the dry down, you get cedar, musk and Madagascar vanilla, which makes the fragrance smooth, soft and long lasting with a cozy trail.

products.title: Riiffs Mystere Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Mystere Eau de Parfum is a soft, elegant floral perfume for women who like sweet and classy scents. It opens fresh and fruity, then turns into creamy white flowers and finally dries down into warm vanilla and musk. The combination feels feminine, gentle and attractive.

products.title: Riiffs Vendome Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Vendôme Eau de Parfum is a warm and classy men’s fragrance with a smooth oriental touch. It starts with fresh bergamot that feels bright and clean on the skin. After a few minutes, soft iris and roasted chestnut come in, giving it a creamy and slightly sweet feel. In the dry down, whiskey, woody notes, and amber create a deep, warm base that smells rich and confident. It feels modern, stylish, and perfect for men who like bold but smooth scents.

products.title: Nusuk Eshq Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Eshq Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and soothing unisex scent from Nusuk Fragrances. It is known for its smooth feel and pleasant, not too sharp or too light, smell. The scent opens with a gentle, sweet tone, then slowly reveals floral and warm notes, finally settling into a creamy, woody base.

products.title: Riiffs Exotic Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Exotic Oud Eau de Parfum is a bold leather fragrance for men who like strong and dark scents. Launched in 2022, this perfume opens with soft floral and warm notes of geranium, amber and iris. After a few minutes, the heart comes with spicy cinnamon and a fresh citrus touch. The base is deep and smoky with leather, tobacco, spices, smoke and woody notes. Riiffs Exotic Oud Eau de Parfum feels creamy, warm and slightly sweet in the drydown.

products.title: Riiffs Surge & Spectra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs R Spectra Eau dePerfum is an assertive and hot fragrance that is both hot and somewhat sweet to the touch of the man. It has a combination of orange blossom and white pepper as the beginning, which makes it fresh and sharp. As it subsides, you have warm violet, nutmeg and sweetness. Amber, vanilla bean and patchouli provide a rich, smooth and extended low in the dry down. It is contemporary, masculine, and suitable for those men who use oriental spicy perfumes that are very rich.

products.title: Riiffs La Femme Bloom Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs La Femme Bloom Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and fresh perfume made for women who love floral and fruity scents. It opens with juicy raspberry and bright citrus mixed with soft jasmine. The middle feels romantic with peony, violet leaf and orange blossom. The base is warm and smooth with musk, vanilla bean and patchouli, giving a classy and long lasting finish.

products.title: Riiffs Exclusive Prive Mystique Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Exclusive Privé Mystique Noir Eau de Parfum is a bold and refined fragrance that captures mystery and masculine elegance for men. Crafted with rich, deep notes, it delivers a powerful yet smooth scent that leaves a lasting impression. Perfect for evening wear and special occasions, this captivating perfume reflects confidence, sophistication, and modern charm. Housed in a sleek 100ml bottle, it is made for the man who appreciates timeless style and distinctive allure.

products.title: Riiffs Stella & Luna Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Stella & Luna Extrait de Parfum is a rich and sweet fragrance made for women who love warm and creamy scents. The opening feels nutty and smooth with black currant, hazelnut, milk and praline, giving a soft gourmand touch. In the heart, rose, jasmine, and iris add a floral beauty, while cacao brings a slight chocolate feel. The base is deep and warm with vanilla, honey, musk and sandalwood that stays on skin for long hours. It feels elegant, cozy and a little addictive.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Ruby Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Ruby Extrait de Parfum is a women's perfume that is warm and elegant, and it is sweet, flowery, and slightly spicy. It opens bright with bergamot, orange and blackcurrant combined with sweet notes and saffron to give it a good first impression. It is smooth and feminine, and as if out of nothing, slow and soft jasmine and violet emerge. The foundation of musk, amber, cashmeran, and moss remains long-lasting on the skin and is comfortable, deep, and luxurious for hours.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Pearl Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Pearl Extrait de Parfum is a tender, sweet and touch spicy female perfume that is rich and contemporary in its touch and feel. The introduction is sweet and crisp with plump rambutan and grapefruit with a touch of cardamom. Bulgarian rose and peony make their appearance in the heart with a touch of romantic floral flavour sprinkled with blackcurrant sweetness. Caramel and incense base is creamy, warm and a bit smoky and thus long-lasting and elegant. This perfume is feminine, self-confident, and suitable for those women who admire sweet flowers with a warm touch.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Onyx Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Onyx Extrait de Parfum is a sweet, creamy and warm perfume that is designed to be used by men and women alike. It begins with gentle vanilla orchid and ylang ylang that is blended in with the touch of whipped cream that is rich and comforting. The heart is serving rose and peony with a small twist of fruity blackcurrant. Caramel, woods and incense render it deep in the dry down, sweet and to a certain extent smoky. It is classy, welcoming and highly enjoyable.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Amethyst Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Amethyst Extrait de Parfum is a warm and sweet perfume oriental fragrance designed to suit women and men. It begins with fat apple, nectarine and raspberry, fresh bergamot with a hint of saffron. You sense in the heart creamy milk, sweet musk and white flowers. It is amber and smooth vanilla and cashmeran at the base that provides a very deep, cozy and lasting finish. It is classy, daring and highly addictive.

products.title: Riiffs Prive Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Prive Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh aromatic scent for men who like clean, bold, and stylish perfumes. Released in 2025, it opens with spicy, crisp tones of Sichuan pepper, green apple and tobacco that feel energetic and modern. The heart brings soft violet, patchouli and cacao, which add a smooth and slightly sweet depth. The base settles into warm Madagascar vanilla, leather and labdanum, giving a creamy, masculine finish that feels classy yet easy to wear daily.

products.title: Riiffs Momento Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Momento Extrait de Parfum is a new unisex scent launched in 2025. Riiffs Momento Extrait de Parfum is a warm, sweet and woody fragrance with a little spicy touch. The scent opens with sugar, saffron and fresh mandarin, giving a sweet and slightly citrus start. In the middle, you get soft tonka bean, romantic Damask rose and creamy agarwood. The base is deep and smooth with amberwood, caramel and cedar, which gives a creamy, woody drydown.

products.title: Riiffs Goodness Oud Rouge Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Goodness Oud Rouge by Riiffs Perfumes is a fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Goodness Oud Rouge was launched in 2023. Top notes are Mango and Bergamot; middle notes are Olibanum and Jasmine; base notes are Vanilla and Sandalwood.

products.title: Riiffs Goodness Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Goodness Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet, oriental floral scent for both men and women. It opens with a romantic Damask rose and a creamy praline note that gives a sweet feel from the start. The middle features sugar, white musk and jasmine sambac, making the scent smooth, light, floral and cozy. Drydown has amber xtreme, vanilla and patchouli, giving a warm, long lasting base with a slightly sweet, woody touch.

products.title: Riiffs Rose de Soleil Eclat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Rose de Soleil Éclat Eau de Parfum is a bright and fruity floral fragrance for women that feels sweet, fresh, and warm. The opening is juicy and lively with mango, Sicilian lemon, wild berries, and a soft touch of pink pepper. Slowly, the heart turns creamy and slightly spicy with ginger and jasmine, blended with smooth tonka bean and vanilla. In the dry down, white musk, amber, and vetiver give a clean, soft, and long-lasting finish. It feels sunny, feminine, and perfect for everyday wear.

products.title: Zimaya Tiramisu Coco Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Zimaya Tiramisu Coco Eau de Parfum is a warm and comforting fragrance. It starts with coffee and amaretto that is slightly nutty and sweet. A couple of minutes later, ice cream, biscuit and vanilla come into the picture, which makes the smell creamy and appetising. The dry down vanilla, brown sugar and amber are warm and sugary, and remain smooth on the skin.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Legacy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Legacy Eau de Parfum is a clean, sharp and confident fresh and powerful men's fragrance. The initial spray is a fresh burst of citrus with a twist of lime and grapefruit, combined with cool mint and gentle lavender. Eventually black pepper and rosemary begin to appear spicy. It has a long-lasting and contemporary masculine smell because the base is made woody and smooth with ambroxan, vetiver and tonka bean.

products.title: Lattafa Petra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Petra Eau de Perrier by Lattafa Perfumes is a creamy and sweet unisex perfume that is warm and a tad bit boozy. The initial spray introduces the splendid rum and juicy plum, which add a dark fruity touch to this spray. Then there comes tuberose and coconut, and it is soft and creamy. The smooth sweet finish of vanilla, musk and praline in the base remains hours long.

products.title: Lattafa Atheeri Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Atheeri Lattafa Perfumes is a floral oriental perfume for women. This is a new fragrance. Atheeri was launched in 2025. Passion Flower and Dew Drop are the highest notes; Orchid and Jasmine are the middle notes; Vanilla and Amberwood are the lowest notes. The first impression is light and fresh with a touch of water and a flowery fragrance, but gradually, it becomes warm and smooth in the heart. The base has vanilla and amberwood that provide a warm, though slightly sweet taste that lingers for hours later. It suits well those female customers who prefer floral perfumes with a soft, warm touch.

products.title: Lattafa Yara Moi Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Yara Moi Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and warm fragrance made for women who enjoy creamy perfumes. It opens with juicy peach and gentle jasmine that feel fresh yet slightly sweet. After some time, the caramel and amber start to come out, giving a rich and cosy vibe. The sandalwood and patchouli in the base make it smooth and long-lasting. It feels feminine, elegant and very comforting.

products.title: Lattafa Atlas Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Atlas Eau de Parfum begins with a powerful sea scent, combined with salt and lemon. The initial spray is extremely refreshing as it is as though you are in front of the ocean when cool wind is blowing against your face. The lemon gives it a slight sharpness and makes it natural and realistic with the salt.

products.title: Ajmal Amir Two Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Amir Two Eau de Parfum from Ajmal fragrances is a rich and modern unisex perfume made for people who like deep and bold scents. The top notes are a spicy and flowery blend, which are warm and slightly fresh. After some time, the fragrance becomes woody and smooth with a soft amber touch. The base notes are dark, smoky and musky, resembling an intense Middle Eastern essence that is very close to skin and very elegant.

products.title: Ajmal Amir One Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Amir One Eau de Parfum is a rich and elegant unisex fragrance made for people who enjoy a balanced mix of fresh, floral and deep woody notes. The top notes are sparkling, citrusy scented bergamot and lemon, along with soothing lavender and clary sage. As it settles, scent brings the mixture of sandalwood, rose, jasmine and soft white flowers that are smooth and flowery. The base is very warm and lasts a long time with the presence of oud, amber and musk, which gives it a classy and slightly royal sensation.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbanna The One Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dolce and Gabbana The One Intense perfume is a strong and dark men's perfume that has a smooth feel of leather. It is introduced with spicy cardamom blended with fresh neroli and cypress, which is fresh and crisp. Gradually, it becomes warm with the notes of cashmeran and soft resin that are warm and comfortable. The foundation contains leather and patchouli, which remain long on skin, which makes this smell powerful, elegant, and ideal among assertive men.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Acqua di Gio Eau de Toilette is a male perfume that was introduced in 1996. It is produced using fresh citrus tones, sea tones and gentle woody tones that are very clean and natural. The introductory is bright, fresh and very gradually becomes liquid and smooth. During the dry down, it is hot and dry. This perfume is light, clean and comfortable to use; it suits everyday and hot seasons.

products.title: Rayhaan Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Elixir Eau de Parfum is a fresh yet warm unisex perfume from Rayhaan Fragrances. Launched in 2024, it carries a smooth, oriental woody style that opens with cool mint and bright bergamot notes, offering a clean, uplifting start. The heart is a mixture of soft lavender and sweet, resinous benzoin, which adds depth and a bit of warmth. Creamy vanilla and tonka bean are softened in the drydown, leaving a warm, sweet, woody path on the skin that feels modern and elegant yet not too heavy.

products.title: Hugo Boss Bottled Elixir Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Hugo Boss Bottled Elixir Parfum Intense is a men's fragrance, an Oriental Spicy fragrance by Hugo Boss. In 2023, it was released and produced by Annick Menardo and Suzy Le Helley. It begins with frankincense and cardamom, making it smoky and spicy. Patchouli and vetiver are added to the heart, and the base is labdanum and cedar to give a deep, woody, long-lasting finish.

products.title: Burberry Brit for Her Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Burberry Brit for Her Eau de Toilette is a sweet and fresh fragrance that women who appreciate simple yet luxurious perfumes can use. The fragrance begins with a combination of green almond and lime, complemented by pear, making it light and cheerful. The smell evolves into a sweet mixture of sugar and almond that give a cozy and relaxing effect. The amber and vanilla base of the perfume forms a softness that is close to the body. This aroma is very classy and soothing, and can be utilised easily by people every day.

products.title: Carolina Herrera 212 Men NYC Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera 212 Men NYC Eau de Toilette is a new, clean, modern perfume that brings the smooth, refined touch of its perfume. The perfume opens with the notes of green, grapefruit and light spices that give the impression of freshness and vigour. The perfume evolves into a calm, sophisticated condition with the soft floral and spicy tones, which are brought out in the process of settling. The base has woody and musky components, and these components stay on the skin longer.

products.title: Al Wataniah Lazuli Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Wataniah Lazuli Eau de Parfum is a fresh yet warm oriental fragrance made for both men and women. It opens with bright citrus notes that feel clean, juicy and uplifting. As the scent settles, soft white florals come forward, adding a smooth and elegant touch. The base is warm amber, which gives the perfume a slightly sweet and long lasting finish.

products.title: Mancera  Amore Caffe Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Amore Caffè Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and cozy unisex perfume made for coffee lovers. This scent opens with a creamy coffee note mixed with soft amaretto, giving a creamy, slightly nutty feel. The middle art feels gourmand and smooth with ice cream and speculoos, which makes it sweet and comforting. The base is deep and addictive with brown sugar, vanilla and ambergris that stays close to the skin and feels very cozy.

products.title: Nusuk Al Mukhtalif Signature Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Al Mukhtalif Signature Extrait de Parfum is a decadent and bold men’s fragrance from the house of Nusuk. Released in 2024, it brings a deep woody aromatic scent style with a strong Middle Eastern touch. The scent opens with a powerful mix of oud, sandalwood, rose, amber, bergamot, neroli and jasmine, which feels warm and slightly fresh at the same time. The middle blends agarwood, patchouli, cedar, lemon, rose and jasmine, giving it a woody floral depth. The base settles into smooth oud, musk and vanilla, leaving a soft, sweet, woody trail that feels classy and long lasting.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Summer Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Summer Oud Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance from Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances. Launched in 2022, it is a refreshing and warm scent with a perfect summer vibe. The scent has a bright and fresh opening formed by the very top notes of saffron, mandarin orange, incense and cypriol. The fragrance then gets warmer and sweeter thanks to the middle notes of rose, cashmere wood, caramel, amber and patchouli. The skin is then treated with a long lasting, rich and smooth trail created by the base of oud, leather, musk, oakmoss and vetiver.

products.title: Neesh Shafran Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Shafran Extrait de Parfum is a wealthy and bold unisex perfume launched in 2024 by the house of Neesh. It is a deep, woody, spicy scent that opens with warm saffron, fruity plum and spicy cardamom and nutmeg. The heart feels smooth and sweet with leather, caramel, brown sugar and soft cashmere wood. The base is dark and long lasting with incense, vanilla, amber, patchouli, sandalwood, moss and vetiver, creating a warm, strong scent trail that smells classy and powerful.

products.title: Azzaro Wanted Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Wanted Eau

Azzaro Wanted Eau de Parfum is a fresh but woody fragrance perfume that is clean, confident and modern to the male gender. It has a crisp and cool feel of juniper berries that is very refreshing. As it drops, sage goes in with a gentle herbal feel which smells smooth and sophisticated. The base has the added dry woody aroma of vetiver that lingers on the skin for long hours. The smell is confident, fashionable and can be worn both on a day-to-day basis or during evenings.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent L’Homme Eau de Toilette is a light and fresh male perfume that is spicy and mild. It is sublime and clean yet also homely and masculine. The introduction begins with oranges and ginger that provide a refreshing effect. Then, soft spices and violet leaf arrive after a long while, which gives a smooth aspect. During the dry down, tonka bean, cedar and vetiver form a warm woody base, which remains softly pinned on the skin.

products.title: Montale Honey Aoud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Honey Aoud Eau de Parfum is a wealthy and deep unisex perfume from the house of Montale. It was launched in 2015 and is known for its strong, sweet honey note mixed with dark oud and warm spices. The scent opens with thick honey and cinnamon, giving a sweet, slightly spicy feel. As it settles, oud, leather and amber come forward, making it bold and intense. The dry down is warm and smooth with vanilla, patchouli and soft floral touches.

products.title: Montale Chocolate Greedy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Chocolate Greedy Eau de Parfum is a creamy, sweet and delicious gourmand fragrance made for people who love chocolate style scents. This perfume smells warm, cozy and edible, almost like fresh cocoa with vanilla and soft sweetness. The opening feels slightly bitter and deep, then slowly turns creamy and smooth on the skin. It is playful, comforting and very addictive, perfect for anyone who enjoys dessert like perfumes.

products.title: Mancera  Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum is a creamy, sweet and fruity unisex perfume. This fragrance opens with a blast of juicy fruits that feel bright, fresh and mouth watering. It has a sweet vibe but still feels classy and smooth. As the perfume settles, soft floral notes start to appear and balance the sweetness very well. The dry down is creamy, warm and musky, which stays on the skin for many hours. Mancera Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum is bold, strong and very long lasting, perfect for people who love fruity and sweet perfumes with power.

products.title: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Jean Paul Gaultier Le Beau Eau de Toilette is a fresh and sweet cologne that is tropical and smooth on the human skin.  Le Beau was launched in 2019. The initial impression is light bergamot providing a clean and citrus feel and then gradually creamy coconut follows which gives a soft and beachy impression. The tonka bean in the foundation is warmly sweet and a little bit nutty in touch and everything remains on the skin through long hours.

products.title: Byredo Tobacco Mandarin Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Byredo Tobacco Mandarin Extrait de Parfum is a unisex perfume that is rich and deep in smell, warm and spicy in nature. The perfume opens with a bitter combination of mandarin, cumin and coriander, which gives the fragrance a fresh but strong smell. The smell builds up into a dark and smooth smell, which has tobacco and leather as its main notes. The scent of the perfume is long-lasting, as the base components of oud, incense and sandalwood produce the strong and luxurious perfume-like aroma which prefer the deep-luxury scent lovers.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdijan Gentle Fluidity Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Gentle Fluidity Gold Eau de Parfum is a warm, smooth and elegant unisex fragrance made for people who love soft sweetness with depth. Launched in 2019, this perfume feels creamy, cozy and classy at the same time. It opens with fresh, spicy notes of juniper berries and nutmeg, which give a clean, airy start. The middle has coriander, adding a soft spicy warmth. The base is where the magic happens, with rich vanilla, soft musk, caramel sweetness and amberwood, creating a long lasting, comforting scent that stays close to the skin.

products.title: Ajmal Evoke Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Evoke Gold Eau de Parfum is a classy and modern men’s perfume from the house of Ajmal. It is made for men who like clean, elegant and confident scents. The fragrance opens fresh and spicy with neroli and pepper, giving a sharp and bright start. The heart feels smooth and warm with orris root, amber and geranium, which adds softness and depth. The base settles into woody tones of cedar and patchouli, making the scent masculine and long lasting. Ajmal Evoke Gold Eau de Parfum is perfect for daily wear, office use and evening outings without feeling heavy or loud.

products.title: Ajmal Amber Wood Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Amber Wood Eau de Parfum is a unisex perfume from Ajmal Perfumes. Launched in 2014, it is a warm and woody fragrance with a perfect balance of spicy, fruity and deep amber notes. The fragrance starts with fresh and aromatic top notes of cardamom, apple, lavender and white pepper. Cedar and orris give a woody and floral note in the middle, while rich amber, patchouli and deep woody notes compose the base.

products.title: Riiffs Inspiro Men Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Inspiro Men Eau de Parfum is a fresh, aromatic fragrance for modern men who like to smell clean yet warm and sweet. Launched in 2024, this scent opens with smooth lavender and spicy cardamom, giving a classy first impression. As it settles, the middle becomes creamy and slightly sweet with tonka bean, amber and soft iris. The base is warm and comforting, with musk, vanilla and cedar that linger nicely on the skin.

products.title: Riiffs Prive Oros Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Prive Oros Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet, floral and woody perfume for women who like creamy, warm scents. It opens with nutty hazelnut mixed with coffee and a light citrus peel touch. The heart brings a white floral feel with tuberose, rose water and soft florals. The drydown becomes cozy and sweet with vanilla, cocoa, musk, cinnamon and cedarwood.

products.title: Riiffs Prive Platinum Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Prive Platinum Eau de Parfum is a fresh woody aromatic scent made for both men and women. It opens with bright citrus notes of lemon zest and orange that feel clean and lively. The heart comes with soft white tea and green fig leaf which gives a smooth and calming vibe. The base is warm and slightly musky with amberwood, cedar, and musk, making the scent feel elegant but still easy to wear daily.

products.title: Riiffs Prive Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Prive Noir Eau de Parfum is a bold leather fragrance for men who like strong and classy scents. Launched in 2023, this perfume opens fresh and slightly spicy, then slowly turns warm, woody and deep. Riiffs Prive Noir Eau de Parfum has a creamy leather base that gives it a dark, powerful feel.

products.title: Riiffs Imperial Noir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Imperial Noir Eau de Parfum is a bold, classy, aromatic, spicy perfume for men who like strong yet smooth perfumes. Launched in 2023, it opens fresh and slightly spicy, with notes of clary sage, bergamot and pink pepper. The heart feels deep and warm with patchouli and myrrh, giving a creamy touch. In the drydown, vanilla bean, tonka and light amber create a sweet, warm finish that feels comforting and masculine.

products.title: Riiffs Rose De Soleil Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Rose De Soleil Eau de Parfum is a sweet, floral and fruity women’s perfume for those who like soft yet noticeable scents. It opens with juicy, fruity notes like peach, red mandarin and nectar, giving a fresh, sweet feel. The middle notes bring floral charm with jasmine, white flowers and creamy vanilla sugar. In the base, maple, syrup, amber and precious woods mix to create a warm sugary finish.

products.title: Riiffs Wonder of Your Pour Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Wonder of Your Pour Homme Eau de Parfum is a warm, spicy and slightly sweet scent from Riiffs house. It is a men’s perfume for those who like strong yet smooth scents that make them feel stylish and confident. The scent opens spicy and warm with chestnut, pink pepper and clove, then becomes soft and aromatic with sage and light amber and finally settles into a creamy, sweet base of tonka bean and vanilla.

products.title: Riiffs Bella Rouge Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Bella Rouge Eau de Parfum is a soft yet bold feminine scent from Riiffs Perfumes. It is a pretty oriental floral perfume that opens with fresh, spicy notes of blood orange, pink pepper and lemon zest, giving a bright, lively feel. The heart opens to romantic damask rose, light freesia and relaxing tea leaf, and the smell is graceful and soft. The base settles into white musk, patchouli and amberwood, providing a warm and slightly sweet end that remains near the skin and is comforting.

products.title: Riiffs Golden Elixir Reserve Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Golden Elixir Reserve Eau de Parfum is a creamy and warm unisex perfume from Riiffs Perfumes. Launched in 2024, it is a sweet, spicy scent profile built with cinnamon, cognac, cardamom and coffee in the opening; praline, dates and tonka bean in the heart and a deep base of vanilla, agarwood and musk.

products.title: Ajmal  Eau d'Oud Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Eau d'Oud Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance made for people who like fresh notes with a deep oud base. It opens with a clean and fresh mix of citrus, bergamot and mint, which feels bright and energetic. The middle is formed of the gentle flowers and the warm spices of such as neroli, ginger, rose and nutmeg that give it a smooth balance. The base settles into a creamy combination of oud, amber, musk and tonka bean, thus imparting warmth, comfort and longevity to the fragrance.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau de Toilette is an up-to-date, fresh male perfume which is clean, vibrant and slightly woody. The perfume begins with a refreshing burst of bright bergamot, ginger and aldehydes that provide a fresh and refreshing kick to the perfume. Then, a few minutes later, lavender, sage and geranium are added and provide a soft aromatic touch. During the dry down, ambergris, vanilla, cedar and olibanum form a soft and somehow warm foundation that remains pleasant on the skin.

products.title: Initio Narcotic Delight Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Initio Narcotic Delight Eau de Parfum is a strong and cosy unisex perfume with the sensation of sweetness, richness and a bit of booze. The initial impression is juicy cherry with pink and black pepper, which offers a spicy and appealing first impression. Then slowly, in a slow cushion of rose comes a heart of smooth cognac, which is deep and addictive. Tobacco, vanilla, tonka, cedar and patchouli are combined in the base to produce a creamy and smoky sweetness that appears to linger on the skin for many hours. This is a perfume that seems strong, stylish and fits the likes of individuals who like strong and sugary perfumes.

products.title: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum is a sweet, fruity and soft perfume that is designed to suit women who place a premium on modern and great style perfumes. The perfume opens with light-hearted and sweet scents of strawberry and raspberry, and cherry berry. The violet and jasmine floral notes come out to produce a feminine touch. Vanilla and musk mixed with the woody in the base notes of the fragrance are warm and smooth on the skin all day long.

products.title: Jo Malone Myrrh & Tonka Cologne Intense
products.body_html: Jo Malone Myrrh and Tonka Cologne Intense is a fragrant, warm and smooth perfume for both men and women. It was released in 2016 and was produced by Mathilde Bijaoui. The fragrance starts with light lavender, diffusing gradually to a heart of myrrh. Creamy tonka bean, vanilla and almond create a sweet, warm and long-lasting sensation in the base. It is stylish, cozy and somewhat addictive.

products.title: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Wood & Wood Intense Men Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Wood & Wood is a men's fragrance which is a wood perfume. It was launched in 2019. The fragrance starts with cardamom, grapefruit and elemi. It is apricot, ambroxan, Virginian cedar and sandalwood. The foundation consists of a woody base, Haitian vetiver and patchouli. It is a daring and warm smell that is heartfelt, masculine and lasting.

products.title: Issey Miyake Fusion D'Issey Extreme Eau De Toilette Intense
products.body_html: Issey Miyake Fusion D'Issey Extreme an Aromatic Fougere perfume that is a men's fragrance. It was released in 2021, with Nathalie Lorson acting as the nose behind this perfume. The smell begins with cardamom and bergamot, followed by coconut, mint, lavender, mineral and solar in the heart. It has a very long-lasting and woody finish that sinks into the sandalwood and patchouli.

products.title: Issey Miyake L'Eau D'Issey Pour Homme Intense Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Issey Miyake L'Eau d'Issey Pour Homme Intense is a men's fragrance of Woody. L’eau d’Issey Pour Homme Intense was introduced in 2007. Behind this perfume, there is Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. It introduces fresh tones of Yuzu, Bergamot, Sweet Orange and Mandarin Orange, and it is succeeded by Nutmeg, Lotus, Cardamom, Cinnamon and Saffron. The foundation is hot and smoky, containing Incense, Papyrus, Ambergris, and Amber.

products.title: Afnan Turathi Electric Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Turathi Electric Eau de Parfum is a fresh, bright and modern unisex perfume. Launched in 2025, this fragrance opens with juicy and citrusy notes that feel clean and energetic. As it settles, soft florals and fruity tones come out, making it smooth and pleasant. The warmth of musk, amber and vanilla in the base gives the perfume a balanced, easy everyday fragrance.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum is a rich and modern unisex perfume with a strong oriental touch. It starts with a fruity and spicy mixture of mango, saffron, citrus and soft florals that are bright but warm at the same time. The middle note is amber, rose, iris and black tea that are smooth and slightly smoky. The base is deep, woody and very long lasting with oud, tonka bean, patchouli, musk and cedar, which gives it a bold and classy finish that feels lavish but is still easy to wear.

products.title: Afnan Rare Reef Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Rare Reef Extrait de Parfum is a fresh, fruity and aromatic unisex perfume from the Afnan house. Launched in 2025, this fragrance feels bright, juicy and smooth at the same time. It opens with a burst of citrus and fresh mint that feels clean and energetic. As it settles, soft fruity and floral notes come out, giving it a calm and slightly sweet touch. The base feels warm and cozy with fig, amberwood and dates, making the scent balanced and easy to wear.

products.title: Afnan Mystique Bouquet Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Mystique Bouquet Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and very feminine fragrance made for women who love fresh floral scents with a fruity touch. It was perfumed in 2024. This perfume starts with a cheerful and playful opening of bright and juicy fruits. Gentle flowers that make the scent clean and elegant come through as the fragrance settles. The base is warm and creamy, with a hint of sweetness, making the scent comforting and long lasting.

products.title: Afnan Historic Sahara Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Historic Sahara Eau de Parfum is a warm and sweet unisex perfume from the house of Afnan. Launched in 2025, this scent feels rich, cozy and a little spicy. The opening is very fresh and spicy due to the presence of cardamom, cinnamon and bergamot. The middle is very comforting and sweet with vanilla, sugar and elemi. The base makes one feel deep and pleased with praline, almond, tonka, musk and ambroxan. It is a smooth oriental vanilla scent that feels modern but still has that desert warmth vibe.

products.title: Le Labo Bergamote 22 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo Bergamote 22 Eau de Parfum is a clean, light, and elegant fragrance, and it is unisex. It was introduced in 2006 and designed by perfumer Daphne Bugey. The initial spray is crisp and sparkling bergamot, which is citrusy and invigorating. Several minutes later, there is an introduction of soft floral and woody sounds, and the foundation becomes a little musky and warm. It is easy yet extremely classy.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is an elegant oriental fragrance for both men and women. Inspired by rich Arabic traditions and royal gatherings, this scent wraps you in warmth, sweetness, and a soft floral touch.

Bin Shaikh combines the beauty of fresh roses, exotic saffron, and earthy oak moss with a sweet heart of bakhoor, sugar, jasmine, and violet. The dry down is deep and comforting with oud, amber, ambroxan, musk, and patchouli creating a luxurious trail.

Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is perfect for those who love sweet, woody scents with a hint of floral freshness. Just a few sprays make you feel confident, royal, and ready for any special moment.

products.title: Mercedez-Benz Club Black Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Mercedes-Benz Club Black Eau de Toilette is a warm and sweet oriental scent made for men who enjoy a bold, smooth and slightly smoky smell. It opens with simple fresh bergamot, moves into a soft mix of incense and jasmine in the middle and dries down to a sweet and cozy base of vanilla, benzoin, ambroxan and woody notes.

products.title: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Rose Amira Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Rose Amira is a deep, rich fragrance designed for women and men. It was released in 2024 and was designed by Delphine Jelk. The perfume is cosy, classy, and a bit oriental. The rose is in the middle, soft yet powerful. Its texture is soft and luxurious, and it clings to the body and is very classy.

products.title: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Cuir Intense Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Cuir Intense is a rich and heavy leather perfume designed for both females and males. It is lush, creamy and somewhat smoky at the onset. Designed by Thierry Wasser in 2024, this perfume is a great leather feel that is pleasant and classy simultaneously. It has the confident feel to it and it is ideal to those who like strong, classy and long-lasting perfumes.

products.title: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum is a 2017 Oriental Woody fragrance that was introduced to the market as a female perfume. It is produced by Thierry Wasser and Delphine Jelk. Fresh lavender and bright bergamot are used in the scent and create a clean and soft opening. The addition of iris, jasmine sambac, and rose brings out a good floral touch in the heart. It is long-lasting and rich with its base being warm and creamy with Tahitian vanilla, sandalwood, coumarin, patchouli, liquorice and benzoin as well.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Dubai Night Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Dubai Night Extrait de Parfum is a rich and warm scent made for men who like deep and classy fragrances. It is a new release from the famous Al Haramain house in 2024. The perfume opens with spicy saffron, fresh bergamot and soft elemi. The heart carries strong agarwood with elegant Bulgarian rose and gentle lily of the valley. The base settles into sweet tonka bean, warm amber, clean white musk and earthy oakmoss.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Bleu Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Bleu Edition Eau de Parfum is a fresh and elegant unisex perfume from Al Haramain Perfumes. This scent brings a clean citrus start with spicy and woody heart and a deep, warm base. The opening gives fresh grapefruit, lemon, mint and pink pepper. The middle note is dominated by ginger vetiver jasmine that contributes soft spice and a floral accent. The base is composed of olibanum, sandalwood, cedar and patchouli, which make it creamy, smooth and long lasting.

products.title: Al Haramain Amber Oud Carbon Edition Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain Amber Oud Carbon Edition Eau de Parfum is a fresh and bold unisex perfume. This scent gives a clean, airy and modern feel with a mix of citrus, herbs and woody notes. It opens with bright bergamot, calming lavender and rosemary. The heart brings sea notes with geranium and sage, giving a cool ocean touch. The base is warm and earthy with moss, amber, vetiver and cedar.

products.title: Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense Eau de Parfum is a strong and classy men’s perfume who like bold and fresh smell. It opens with a bright citrus touch of bergamot and lemon with soft elemi. The middle notes create a woody and floral landscape with lily of the valley and jasmine, which is creamy and clean at the same time. The base is warm and long lasting with musk, patchouli and amber that stays on the skin.

products.title: Rabanne Rose 1969 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rabanne Rose 1969 Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, this scent offers a creamy, floral and warm spicy style that feels classy yet bold. It opens with a lively mix of black pepper and juicy lychee, offering a fresh, spicy sweet start. The heart blooms with soft damask rose and warm amber, giving a smooth floral warmth. The base note of patchouli adds depth and a slightly earthy touch that blends nicely and stays long on skin.

products.title: Rabanne Mesh Metal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rabanne Mesh Metal Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex scent. Launched in 2024, it offers a fresh citrus opening, soft floral notes and warm base tones. The fragrance opens with bright notes of lime, bigarade and petitgrain, giving it a crisp, slightly bitter citrus feel. In the middle sits an orange blossom, adding a light floral sweetness. The drydown settles into ambergris, giving a soft, warm, skin like scent that feels clean, airy and slightly musky.

products.title: Rabanne Midnight Sex Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rabanne Midnight Sex Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume. It is a smooth, floral, fruity scent made with creamy coconut in the opening, white florals in the middle and soft sandalwood in the dry down. Rabanne Midnight Sex Eau de Parfum feels warm, slightly sweet and a little sensual, but still clean and elegant.

products.title: Rabanne After Club Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rabanne After Club Eau de Parfum is a new unisex scent from Rabanne Fragrances. Launched in 2024, it is a smooth woody, aromatic fragrance that feels clean, warm and slightly sweet. The scent opens with fresh lavender, then moves into a soft heart of vanilla and labdanum and settles into a warm amber base.

products.title: Le Labo Lys 41 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo Lys 41 Eau de Parfum is a white and cream floral perfume that is oriented to women who are fond of white flowers. It is warm, sunny, and sweet, to some extent. The fragrance opens with jasmine and lily softness, giving the perfume a very rich floral touch, and changes gradually more creamy with vanilla and white musk. It is smelly, posh, silky and highly feminine. This perfume suits an individual who prefers perfumes of classy, floral fragrances that remain pleasant enough to be noticed and beautiful.

products.title: Le Labo Another 13 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo Another 13 Eau de Parfum is an unisex perfume that is soft but mysterious, and clean, musky, and faintly woody. It begins with a fresh touch of pear, apple and a sweet tang of citrus, which is airy and smooth. Gradually, the ambrette and the jasmine enter, with a warm musky touch. During the dry down, Iso E Super and Cetalox form a skin-like woody smell that is close to the skin but is long-lasting. It is contemporary, sparse, and subdued hard.

products.title: Le Labo Matcha 26 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo Matcha 26 is a gentle and relaxed unisex perfume, which is clean, creamy, and a bit sweet. It is launched with a cool note of green tea, which is not sharp. Little by little, the sweetness of fig enters into it and renders it cosy and warm. The dry down is soft woods and musk, which remain near the skin. It smells basic, very luxurious and very easy to wear on a day-to-day basis.

products.title: Le Labo Noir 29 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo The Noir 29 Eau de Parfum is a heavy, woody and slightly smoky perfume for both men and women. It is peaceful yet also brash, simultaneously. It is scented after black tea; therefore, it has that dry, warm and slightly sweet feel. It is first open, and then gradually dark, smooth, and reassuring. Fits well with individuals who are fond of beautiful and noble perfumes.

products.title: Rasasi Royal Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Royal Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh yet classy men’s perfume for those who like a clean but strong smell. It opens with watery sea notes mixed with citrus and green touch, then slowly turns floral and soft in the middle. The drydown is warm, woody and musky, which gives a creamy, long lasting feel.

products.title: Montblanc Individuel Tonic Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Montblanc Individuel Tonic Eau de Toilette is a fresh yet warm scent that was introduced in 2018, made for everyday wear. It opens with a clean mix of mint, juniper berries, bergamot and pineapple that feels cool and energetic. The middle has soft floral notes like geranium, violet and orange blossom, which add smoothness. The base settles into woody, sweet tones of sandalwood, musk, vanilla and a hint of dark chocolate, giving a calm, modern finish.

products.title: Dunhill Mongolian Cashmere Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Mongolian Cashmere Eau de Parfum is a gentle and elegant perfume to men, which is warm and soft on the skin. It commences with a light spicy touch of pink pepper blended with fresh mandarin orange that is clean and fresh. Gradually, it shifts into a drying floral core of orris, geranium and rose that is relaxing and refined. The foundation of suede, amber and musk remains warm and comfortable for many hours, as soft cashmere.

products.title: Giorgio Armano My Way Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: My Way Intense Giorgio Armani is a female oriental flower fragrance. It was released in 2021, and the nose behind this fragrance is Carlos Benaïm. It begins with bitter orange and orange blossom, which makes the beginning of the fragrance very bright and slightly sweet. The rich Indian tuberose, which feels creamy and strong, is in the heart. Madagascar vanilla and sandalwood are used in the base to give a warm and long-lasting touch.

products.title: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau de Parfum is a new floral perfume designed to appeal to women who prefer soft and classy scents. This perfume was introduced in 2020, and it begins with bright orange blossom and bergamot that is both clean and refreshing.
