The heart adds the creamy tuberose and Indian jasmine, which makes it feel richly floral. Vanilla, white musk and cedar in the base give it a feeling of warmth and smoothness, causing the scent to remain mild and cosy throughout the hours.

products.title: Montblanc Vetiver Glacier Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montblanc Vetiver Glacier Eau de Parfum is a fresh, clean and woody scent made for men who like calm and classy perfumes. This fragrance feels cool, green and slightly earthy, like fresh mountain air. The vetiver note gives it a natural and elegant touch, while juniper adds a light freshness. Sandalwood in the base makes it smooth and soft, not loud or sharp. It is a simple, modern men’s perfume and very easy to wear.

products.title: Mancera  Red Tobacco Intense Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Red Tobacco Intense Extrait de Parfum is a very strong, bold and dark fragrance made for people who love heavy scents. This was launched in 2023 as a more powerful and creamier version of the original Red Tobacco. It opens spicy and smoky, then slowly turns warm, sweet and woody. The high oil concentration makes it long lasting and very intense, so even small sprays are enough.

products.title: Al Wataniah Kayaan Classic Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Wataniah Kayaan Classic Eau de Parfum is a smooth, warm and classy unisex perfume from Al Wataniah. It opens with fresh citrus notes that feel clean and bright. Slowly, the scent turns soft, spicy and floral in the middle, giving it a rich and elegant feel. The base of the fragrance contains sweet and creamy woody elements, which produce a comforting scent that lasts for a long time. Al Wataniah Kayaan Classic Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who enjoy oriental vanilla fragrances with a modern touch.

products.title: Ex Nihilio Blue Talisman Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ex Nihilio Blue Talisman Eau de Parfum is a clean, bright, smooth, fresh and modern fragrance. It has a juicy pear and fresh citrus that is light and happy to touch on the skin. Ginger is followed by a soft spicy, then a soft floral heart of orange blossom and woody. The bottom is warm and musky and has smooth woods that are long-lived. This perfume is comfortable, cool and sophisticated, to be used in everyday life or during some special occasions.

products.title: Mancera  Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum is a deeper, more decadent version of the original Cedrat Boise. This Mancera Cedrat Boise Intense Extrait de Parfum feels bolder, smoother and more long lasting on the skin. It starts with fresh citrus aromas, blended with black currant and spice, for a sharp, classy opening. Leather, sandalwood, oud, patchouli and jasmine all intertwine and combine to form a warm, rather smoky heart as it settles. It is creamy, musky at the base, contains ambergris, oakmoss, vanilla and white musk and lasts hours and hours on the skin.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Stronger With You Parfume is a rich and confident, warm and deep scent of a man's perfume. It begins with a spicy hint of pink pepper blended with fresh mandarin, which is a bright yet strong start. Lavender, sage, and cinnamon gradually enter and smooth out the fragrance and put a somewhat sweet touch on it. The chestnut, vanilla and leather base is long-lasting, creamy, and warm. This perfume seems contemporary, robust, and suitable for men who adopt strong scents.

products.title: Versace Eros Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eros Parfum is an Oriental Fougere perfume product by Versace, a male perfume. In 2021, Versace Eros Parfume was released. The perfume opens with fresh, brisk aromas of mint and lemon, a subtle spicy note of black pepper, elemi, and litsea cubeba. The heart offers a pleasant and fragrant combination of green apple, geranium, lavender, sage and pomarose. Tonka bean, amber, vanilla, patchouli and benzoin are used in the base to provide a warm and sweet, long-lasting finish that is rich and masculine.

products.title: French Avenue Royal Blend Nero Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Royal Blend Nero Extrait de Parfum is a bold, warm and spicy unisex fragrance made for people who like strong and wealthy scents. It opens with a fresh yet spicy mix of nutmeg, apple and bergamot that feels smooth and classy. The middle brings heat and depth with cinnamon, dry woods and saffron, giving it a dark, royal touch. The base is sweet, creamy and long lasting with vanilla, tonka bean, benzoin and musk.

products.title: French Avenue Spectre Wraith Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Spectre Wraith Eau de Parfum is a dark, bold and smooth woody aquatic fragrance made for men who like strong, modern scents. It opens with a rich and boozy feel and slowly turns warm, earthy and slightly sweet on the skin. The mix of rum, spices, coffee, woods and sugar cane gives this perfume a deep and addictive smell. French Avenue Spectre Wraith Eau de Parfum stays balanced, strong but not too loud and feels premium from start to end.

products.title: French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum is a dark, bold and smoky leather men’s perfume made for those who like strong scents. It was launched in 2023 and opens with incense, gaiac wood and saffron, which feels warm and mysterious. The middle brings leather with a soft, sweet touch from violet and sugar cane. The base is deep and smoky with patchouli, sandalwood, woods and black musk that stays long on skin. Overall, French Avenue Spectre Eau de Parfum feels powerful, mature and very confident.

products.title: French Avenue Lumiere Garcon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Lumiere Garcon Eau de Parfum is a modern oriental fragrance made for both men and women. Launched in 2024, this scent feels warm, spicy and slightly sweet from the very first spray. It opens with fresh spice and green notes, slowly turning creamy and deep as it settles on the skin. The mix of pepper, herbs, soft fruits and smoky woods base gives it a classy yet relaxed feel.

products.title: French Avenue Sultan the Founder Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Sultan The Founder Eau de Parfum is a creamy oriental woody fragrance made for both men and women. It opens strong and deep with classic Middle Eastern vibes and slowly turns warm and smooth on skin. The blend feels bold, royal and confident, made for people who like strong perfumes with character. It has a dark woody feel with animalic warmth in the base that stays for long hours.

products.title: French Avenue Royal Blend Vintage Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Royal Blend Vintage Extrait de Parfum is a creamy, warm and classy unisex perfume made for people who love deep and bold scents. It was introduced in 2025 and opens with a sweet, slightly boozy touch of plum mixed with herbal davana, which feels smooth and vintage style. The heart brings immortelle, giving a warm honey like feel that feels cozy and elegant. As it dries down, the base becomes strong and comforting with tobacco, tolu balsam and vanilla.

products.title: Paris Corner Taskeen Lactea Divina Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Taskeen Lactea Divina Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, it is a creamy, sweet scent with a soft floral and warm dessert like feel. The fragrance opens with cacao and incense that smell creamy and slightly smoky. The heart comes with tuberose and jasmine, which adds a soft floral touch. The base settles into milk, vanilla and tonka bean, giving a cozy, smooth sweetness that feels comforting and addictive on the skin.

products.title: Paris Corner Taskeen Caramel Cascade Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Taskeen Caramel Cascade Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy, gourmand scent made for both men and women. Launched in 2024, it brings a delicious blend of caramel and milk in the opening, followed by soft notes of tonka bean and honey in the middle. The drydown settles into a warm base of vanilla and white musk, giving it a smooth, cozy finish that feels comforting and addictive.

products.title: Fragrance World Francique 63.55 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Francique 63.55 Eau de Parfum by Fragrance World is a smooth, cosy, and oriental woody perfume that is produced to suit both genders (women and men). It is sophisticated, serene and soothing to the initial spurt. The fragrance starts with subtle spice, then gradually transitions into creamy and classy, and then long-lasting, sweet woody base. The perfume is ideal for those who enjoy the use of soft, warm, and comfortable perfumes to wear daily and evenings.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Coffee Break Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Coffee Break Eau de Toilette is a soft and cozy perfume. It feels like sitting in a calm café with warm coffee and quiet vibes. The scent was introduced in 2019 and is smooth, creamy and relaxing, not loud at all. The opening feels slightly spicy and fresh. Gradually, it becomes the smell of a milky coffee with lavender, clean and relaxing. It has a warm, vanilla and woodsy base that's extremely comfy and wearable.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Si Passione Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Sì Passione Eau de Parfum is a light, floral, female fragrance, which is refreshing, sweet and very emotional. It begins with a fat pear and black currant with airy spiciness, which bruises the skin and is alive. Later on, there are soft flowers such as roses and jasmine, which make it very feminine. The woody and vanilla foundation is warm and makes it soft, classy, and durable on everyday or special occasions.

products.title: Burberry Her Petals Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Her Petals Eau de Parfum is a bouquetine fragrance that is aimed at girls who like gentle and glamorous aromas. The perfume starts off with sweet and fresh wild berries, then evolves to the soft violet and jasmine core that results in clean, floral and soft scents. The amber base produces a calm and gentle effect that is maintained close to the skin. The perfume is feminine but still modern and easy to wear that is why it can be used in everyday life.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Gold Fantasy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Gold Fantasy Eau de Parfum is a luxurious and stylish women's perfume experience, which is combined of sweet, warm and sophisticated components. The perfume starts out with an almond, which evolves into a creamy and smooth feel. The core of the perfume grows white flowers using jasmine sambac and tuberose that produce a feminine and classy aroma. A mix of cacao and tonka bean in the foundation produces a sweet and warm aroma and feels longer on the skin. The fragrance offers an assertive and luxurious feel, and this appeals to women who like strong perfumes.

products.title: Nishane Ani X Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Nishane Ani X Extrait de Parfum is a rich and modern unisex scent. Launched in 2023, it is a deeper and more intense take on the famous Ani DNA with a fresh fruity opening and creamy sweet woody base. The fragrance opens with bright lemon, bergamot, ginger, melon, cardamom, water notes and pink pepper that feel fresh and lively. The heart brings green apple, black currant, lavender, patchouli, sage and rose, which add a soft, fruity and aromatic touch. The base has smooth vanilla, sandalwood, cashmere wood, cedar, ambergris and white musk that blend and create a warm, sweet trail that stays long and feels elegant.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Privée Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Privée Eau de Parfum is an elegant yet bold women perfume that has a high quality leather fragrance. The perfume begins with light smoothness that goes on to form warm deep scent that is full of confidence and sophistication. The perfume offers a modern yet a trendy look that is powerful but not overly conspicuous. The perfume is comparable to the women who love strong, elegant perfumes, which provide a unique experience that is experienced throughout the day.

products.title: Maison Francis Kurkdijan Grand Soir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Grand Soir Eau de Parfum is a creamy, warm and elegant unisex perfume launched in 2016 by the luxury French perfume house Maison Francis Kurkdjian. It opens with a smooth mix of Spanish labdanum and a light touch of orange, which feels warm and slightly sweet. The heart brings lavender and Siam benzoin, which add a calm, resin like depth. The base is deep and comforting with amber, vanilla, tonka bean, musk and cedar, giving the perfume its signature long lasting warmth.

products.title: Zimaya Mazaaj Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Zimaya Mazaaj Eau de Parfum is a rich and modern fragrance that feels warm, slightly spicy and smooth. The scent opens with a fresh touch of citrus and spices which gives a bright start. After some time aromatic notes begin to appear, adding a soft and elegant feel. As it settles down, woody and amber notes create a warm base that stays on the skin for many hours and gives a classy masculine vibe.

products.title: Prada Infusion D'Amande Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Infusion d'Amande by Prada is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. Infusion d'Amande was launched in 2015. The nose behind this fragrance is Daniela Andrier.

products.title: Rasasi Daarej Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Daarej Pour Femme Eau de Parfum is a sweet, soft and elegant women's fragrance. It opens with juicy fruity notes of peach, orange and bergamot mixed with fresh green accords that feel bright and happy. The heart comes with creamy white florals like jasmine, tuberose and orchid blended with heliotrope and lily-of-the-valley, giving a powdery, feminine touch. The dry down is warm and cozy with caramel, musk, sandalwood, vetiver, amber and patchouli creating a sweet yet classy scent trail that feels smooth and comforting.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Zeleny Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Zeleny Eau de Parfum is a fresh and vibrant unisex perfume. Launched in 2023, it opens with a juicy and fruity burst of grapefruit, tangerine, strawberry and pineapple. The middle notes is floral with jasmine, orchid, peony and a touch of vanilla. Finally, it develops into a warm and luxurious base of oakmoss, musk and woody notes, leaving a smooth and lasting scent suitable for all events.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex fragrance. Launched in 2023, it carries a warm oriental woody scent profile that blends fruity herbal freshness with deep woody richness. The opening starts with davana, bergamot and pink pepper, giving a slightly sweet spicy feel. The heart unfolds into creamy agarwood, oud, amber and rosemary that create a warm aromatic body. The base settles into leather, vetiver and musk, which adds depth, softness and a long lasting trail. The blend feels smooth, bold and balanced with a classy Middle Eastern touch.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Fusion Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Fusion Eau de Parfum is a fresh, fruity, floral unisex scent from Paris Corner fragrances. It starts with juicy, sweet fruits such as litchi, red apple, black currant and a hint of zesty Italian lemon, which makes it bright and playful. The heart opens gradually with gentle jasmine sambac, romantic Taif rose and powdery pansy fragrances that are smooth and light. The base settles into warm, creamy vanilla, musk, sandalwood, cedar and the smell is comfortable, sweet and long lasting with a soft, woody finish.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Pistachio Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Pistachio Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy, unisex scent. Launched in 2023, it is a dessert style fragrance profile made with pistachio, ice cream, bergamot, hazelnut, cardamom and rum (top notes); pear, jasmine, peony, geranium, raspberry and white peach (heart notes) and whipped cream, marshmallow, cotton candy, tonka bean and cedarwood (base notes) blended softly into a playful and smooth composition with gourmand sweetness and fruity floral touch that feels cozy and addictive.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Felicity Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Felicity Eau de Parfum is a soft, pretty and happy feeling women’s perfume for those who like sweet floral perfumes. It begins with the bubbly, fruity smell of champagne, cassis and freesia that are fresh and a bit sparkling. The middle is light jasmine, rose and musk that is clean and feminine. The dry down is warm, creamy and sugary with vanilla and musk, leaving a soft, sweet scent that lingers near and comforting.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Confection Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Confection Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy and playful scent made for women who enjoy dessert like perfumes. It opens with juicy pear and fluffy whipped cream notes that feel soft and tasty. The heart has floral jasmine and ylang ylang mixed with warm cashmeran, which adds a cozy feel. The base dries down to smooth vanilla, marshmallow and sandalwood, leaving a sugary, soft and comforting trail that feels feminine and addictive.

products.title: Khadlaj Island Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Island Extrait de Parfum is a women's and men's perfume, a fruity woody fragrance. Island was launched in 2024. The ingredients include Pineapple, Iris, Ginger and Cypress as the top notes, Coconut and Woodsy Notes as middle notes and Tonka, Sandalwood, Amber and Ambergris as the base notes.

products.title: Paris Corner Minya Cocolush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Minya Cocolush Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet, fruity and floral scent with a creamy gourmand twist. Launched in 2024, this fragrance opens with fresh, juicy notes of coconut water, raspberry and pear that feel light and happy. The heart blooms with jasmine and freesia, giving a gentle floral touch. The dry down turns warm and tasty with macarons, musk and amber, making the scent cozy, smooth and slightly dessert like but not heavy.

products.title: Paris Corner Rifaaqat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Rifaaqat Eau de Parfum is a warm, spicy, unisex perfume from Paris Corner fragrances. Launched in 2023, it carries a bold oriental scent style built with black pepper, elemi and pink pepper in the opening; olibanum and saffron in the heart; and a smooth base of vanilla and cedarwood.

products.title: Khadlaj Cream Velvet Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Cream Velvet Extrait de Parfum is a warm and sweet unisex perfume that is touchy, rich and comfortable. It begins with creamy buttery caramel, which smells creamy and smooth on the initial spray. Then honey and tonka begin to glare, to be a deep sweet heart with a little flowery touch of jasmine. Vanilla, musk and amber fill the dry down and therefore, make it lasting and warm. It is fancy, contemporary and just ideal for those who are fond of sweet gourmand perfumes.

products.title: Khadlaj Karus Blu Spice Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Karus Blu Spice Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is Citrus Aromatic and a men's perfume. The initial impression is fresh tea and bright bergamot, which is clean and somewhat sharp. Neroli and ginger gradually emerge after a while, providing a warm and smooth feel. Cinnamon is used in the dry down to bring a light spicy sweetness that is clung near skin throughout the hours. It is contemporary, new and assertive masculine.

products.title: Khadlaj Karus Secret Musk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Karus Secret Musk Eau de Parfum is a warm and sweet unisex perfume that is smooth and slightly creamy. It begins with a sweet spicy saffron and juicy red fruits then gradually switches to a rich tonka bean, rose and chocolate heart that is warm and deep. The musky and amber base remains on the skin for long hours with a soft and noticeable mark. It is contemporary, daring and somewhat addictive.

products.title: Khadlaj Vanilla Dunes Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Island Vanilla Dunes Extrait de Parfum is a sweet, warm oriental vanilla perfume for both women and men. It starts with a creamy vanilla with gentle spices, which is rich and smooth. There is a gentle, floral touch that scoots in slowly, then falls into a praline and musky bottom. The smell is warm, a little bit spicy, and very lovely, which suits those who are fond of sweet and warm perfumes.

products.title: Rasasi Hawas Elixir Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Hawas Elixir Eau de Parfum is a creamy and modern unisex fragrance from the house of Rasasi. Launched in 2024, this scent brings a sweet, fresh and warm profile made with mint, bergamot and artemisia (top notes); dark chocolate, lavender and benzoin (heart notes); and vanilla, tonka bean and white musk (base notes).

products.title: French Avenue Coco Morado Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Coco Morado Eau de Parfum is a bold and deep unisex fragrance for those who enjoy dark, sweet and woody scents. It opens with spicy warmth from cinnamon, saffron, nutmeg and ginger, which feels creamy and slightly sharp at first. As the perfume settles, you start getting heavy oud, incense, dates, caramel and amberwood notes that feel sweet, smoky and resin like. In the dry down, leather, vanilla, cacao butter, musk and patchouli come together to give a creamy, warm and long lasting base that feels luxurious and strong.

products.title: French Avenue Opus Magnum Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Opus Magnum Extrait de Parfum is a deep, creamy and bold unisex fragrance. Launched in 2025, this perfume opens with a smoky, spicy touch of incense and cardamom mixed with fresh basil and bergamot. As it settles, the middle brings warm tobacco, soft lavender and a slightly bitter note of fenugreek that gives it a unique twist. The base is heavy, warm and long lasting with Peru balsam, oud, amber and tonka bean, making the scent feel smooth, dark and comforting.

products.title: Fragrance World Night Club Green Tweed Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fragrance World Night Club Green Tweed Eau de Parfum is a clean and fresh perfume of the male gender that is soft, green and sophisticated to touch. It begins with a strong lemon verbena scent, which is cool and crisp to the skin. Gradually, iris and violet leaves provide a touch of smooth green, which proves relaxing and sophisticated. Sandalwood and ambroxan form the base, which leaves a warm woody finish that lasts for hours. Such a smell is contemporary, clean, and highly comfortable.

products.title: French Avenue Moonstone Noire Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Moonstone Noire Eau de Parfum is a dark, smooth and classy unisex fragrance from the house of French Avenue. Launched in 2024, this scent focuses on deep leather tones mixed with woody and creamy notes. The fragrance opens softly and slowly becomes creamy and warm, making it perfect for people who like bold but balanced perfumes.

products.title: French Avenue Moonstone Bleu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Moonstone Bleu Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume with a cool, clean and slightly dark feel. It opens with fresh watery and metallic notes mixed with peppery spice, giving a sharp and airy start. As it settles, soft florals, beeswax and leather come in, adding smooth warmth and depth. The base feels creamy and comforting with musk, honey, woods, and amber.

products.title: Creed Original Santal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Creed Original Santal Eau de Parfum by Creed is a warm and spicy woody perfume that is suitable for men and women. It is luxurious within the initial spray. Scent is based upon the sandalwood and light spices, which are creamy and feel royal and confident. It is ideal for individuals who enjoy powerful but cosy perfumes that remain with them throughout the day.

products.title: Rue Broca Theoreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca Théoreme Eau de Parfum is a fresh, warm perfume for men, and simultaneously clean, spicy and smooth. It plays out with bright citrus that provides a sharp and energetic opening. Gradually, the amber and woody tones appear, bringing the warmth and richness. The musk, spices and patchouli in the dry down leave a strong and lasting trail. It is contemporary, secure and comfortable.

products.title: Antonio Banderas Blue Seduction Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Antonio Banderas Blue Seduction Eau de Toilette is a fresh, clean and slightly sweet men’s perfume that feels very easy to wear. It has a cool and energizing start that is opened up with juicy fruity notes and fresh mint. The heart is spicy and watery with the sounds that are modern and youthful. The base is warm and soft with woody and amber shades which remain intimate to the skin.

products.title: Rue Broca Theoreme Matrix Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca Theoreme Matrix Eau de Parfum is a men's woody-spicy perfume released in 2024. It is pineapple, bergamot, grapefruit, and black currant, fresh and fruity, with a sharp, juicy first note. It settles down with patchouli and lavender to give it a deeper look, cedar and jasmine to give it a smooth touch. It is warm, strong, and long-lasting as the base is full of oakmoss, saffron, woods and musk.

products.title: Rue Broca L'Alliance Stellar Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rue Broca L'Alliance Stellar Eau de Parfum is a deep and warm unisex fragrance that feels rich and woody from the first spray. The opening comes with smoky incense mixed with sharp rhubarb and earthy vetiver, giving it a bold start. Slowly, rose and sweet tonka blend with amber in the heart, adding warmth and smoothness. The base of oud, sandalwood, cedar, and amber gives a strong woody finish that stays for long hours on skin.

products.title: Nautica Voyage N 83 Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Nautica Voyage N-83 Eau de Toilette is a fresh aquatic scent for men from the house of Nautica. It is inspired by ocean breezes and cool sea air, giving a clean sporty vibe. The scent opens with fresh sea notes, peppermint and petitgrain, moves into a soft, spicy heart of lavender, cardamom and nutmeg and settles into a smooth base of musk, cedar and sandalwood. The blend feels fresh, slightly spicy and woody at the same time, making it a very easy everyday men’s perfume for those who like clean marine scents.

products.title: Nautica Voyage Sport Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Nautica Voyage Sport Eau de Toilette is a fresh, sporty men’s perfume from Nautica Fragrances. It is a clean ocean style scent made with sea notes, citrus and sea salt in the opening; apple, geranium, palm leaf and green pepper in the middle; and musk, vetiver, patchouli and Brazilian redwood in the base. The smell feels fresh, salty, green and a little woody, giving a cool beach day vibe that is easy to wear and not heavy.

products.title: Montblanc Legend Night Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montblanc Legend Night Eau de Parfum is a dark, smooth and classy men’s fragrance from the house of Montblanc. It opens fresh and spicy with mint, cardamom and bergamot, which feels clean but also a little warm. Slowly it moves into soft fruity and woody notes like apple, lavender and cedar that feel calm and confident. The base is deep and sensual with vanilla, musk, patchouli and vetiver, giving the scent a night time, elegant feel.

products.title: Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum For Her
products.body_html: Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum is a women's perfume of a floral nature. It was introduced in 2010 and is renowned for its soft, fresh, and feminine smell. The fragrance starts with peony, citrus and mandarin orange that provide a fresh and light beginning to it. The heart contains roses and osmanthus, giving a floral smoothness. Sandalwood and patchouli are used in the base to produce a warm and classy finish that remains soft on the skin.

products.title: Jimmy Choo Illicit Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Jimmy Choo Illicit Eau de Parfum is a Women Floral perfume. Illicit was launched in 2015. The nose in this perfume is Anne Flipo. It begins with new and hot tones of ginger and bitter orange. It contains jasmine sambac, orange blossom and rose in the heart. The foundation is warm and salty with honey, amber, caramel, vanilla, sandalwood and wood of cashmere.

products.title: Dunhill Signature Amalfi Citrus Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: The Dunhill Signature Amalfi Citrus Eau de Parfum is a fresh and clean perfume that is bright and classy on the skin of men. It starts off with a citrusy burst of lemon, bergamot and orange that is very fresh and invigorating. Gradually, it passes into a creamy centre of neroli, green tea and light spices, which are soothing and graceful. Vetiver, musk and soft woods form the base to providea clean woody finish which remains fresh on skin. This perfume is relaxed, luxurious and easy to wear.

products.title: Davidoff Essentials Blue Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Davidoff Essentials Blue Eau de Toilette is the everyday perfume that offers a clean and fresh smell to men. The perfume starts with citrus, mint and lavender, which is refreshing and invigorating. The perfume is formed together with jasmine and basil which produce a light spicy scent. The final stage is due to the amber, musk and cedarwood that form a smooth woody scent. The perfume comes out as a simple male fragrance that is appropriate for everyday usage.

products.title: Diptyque L'eau Papier Eau de Toilette (Limted Edition)
products.body_html: Diptyque L'Eau Papier Eau de Toilette (Limited Edition) is a clean, soft, and woody perfume intended to be used by men and women. It is so soothing, cool and very comfortable to the skin. The perfume is light and airy, with the fresh paper, but quickly becomes warm with soft woods and soft musk. It is neither loud nor sharp; it is kept close and very modern and peaceful. An ideal choice of banana jeans and leisure.

products.title: Marc Antoine Barrois Tilia Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Marc Antoine Barrois Tilia Eau de Parfum is a soft, airy and elegant unisex fragrance. It feels bright, floral and very comforting on the skin. The scent opens with fresh lime blossom mixed with jasmine sambac and broom, giving it a light, sunny feel. The heart turns creamy and smooth with heliotrope, orange blossom and vetiver. The base is clean, woody and slightly musky with Ambrofix™ and Georgywood, making the scent long lasting and modern.

products.title: Tom Ford Soleil Neige Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Soleil Neige Eau de Parfum is a light and mellow floral woody musk perfume for women and men. At the same time, it is clean, bright and a bit creamy. The onset is gentle citrus bergamot and light carrot seed note, which is airy. Then there come jasmine, white flowers and roses gradually, and make it elegant. The vanilla and benzoin base offer a warm and soft finish, which remains well on the skin.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Pour Homme
products.body_html: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Pour Homme is a cool, spicy and warm fragrance of men with a classy touch. It is fresh and crisp lemon, which is clean and vibrant. Gradually, the smell gets deep and soft with a powerful coffee aroma in the middle that makes it bold and masculine. The patchouli base provides a feeling of earthiness and woodiness, which remains on the skin for a long time. This perfume is assertive, trendy, and befits males who enjoy high but moderate odours.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Pour Femme
products.body_html: Devotion Eau de Parfum Intense Pour Femme is a rich and sweet fragrance that is targeted to women who are fond of warm vanilla perfumes. It begins with a gentle nutty feeling of hazelnut, which is comfortable and smooth. Gradually, orange blossom enters and provides a sweet floral flavour. During the dry down, creamy vanilla remains near to the skin and spends hours in the perfum,e forming the feeling of elegance, comfort and special moments.

products.title: Messi Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Chocolate Greedy Eau de Parfum is a creamy, sweet and delicious gourmand fragrance made for people who love chocolate style scents. This perfume smells warm, cozy and edible, almost like fresh cocoa with vanilla and soft sweetness. The opening feels slightly bitter and deep, then slowly turns creamy and smooth on the skin. It is playful, comforting and very addictive, perfect for anyone who enjoys dessert like perfumes.

products.title: Rasasi Fattan Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Fattan Pour Femme Eau de Parfum is a graceful, women’s perfume. It is a soft yet creamy oriental style perfume, featuring fresh citrus and spicy top notes, blended with earthy woods and gentle florals in the middle and finished with warm, sweet base notes. The mix of pink pepper, bergamot, lemon, patchouli, vetiver, cedar, amber and oakmoss creates a smooth, elegant scent that feels classy yet easy to wear daily.

products.title: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Untamed Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Qaeed Al Fursan Untamed Eau de Parfum is a warm and spicy woody fragrance for women and men. It opens with a strong mix of cinnamon, cardamom and a little citrus touch of mandarin. After some time, it becomes sweeter with caramel and soft lavender. The base feels deep and rich with amber, woods and vetiver, giving a bold and long-lasting finish.

products.title: Lattafa Najdia Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Najdia Intense Eau de Parfum is a fresh and powerful men’s fragrance that feels vibrant and modern. The first impression is juicy pineapple and apple that bring a sweet, fruity kick, then slowly mint and ginger add a cool, spicy freshness. As it settles, marine notes and lavender give a clean feel, while tonka bean and sandalwood in the base create a smooth, warm finish that lasts for hours.

products.title: French Avenue Liquid Brun Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Liquid Brun Eau de Parfum is a warm, sweet and woody men’s perfume for those who enjoy creamy, cozy scents. Launched in 2024, this perfume opens with spicy, fresh notes of cinnamon, cardamom, bergamot and soft orange blossom. The middle is smooth, creamy, and tastes of bourbon, vanilla, elemi and has a soothing impression. It has a deep and addictive base with praline, ambroxan, guaiac wood and musk that leave a sweet woody scent that is modern and bold, yet most of all wearable.

products.title: French Avenue Royal Blend Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Royal Blend Eau de Parfum is a creamy and smooth unisex fragrance launched in 2023. It opens with a bold mix of cognac, cinnamon and plum that feels deep and slightly sweet. The heart brings soft iris with smoky myrrh, giving the perfume a calm and royal touch. When it settles, vanilla, tonka and sandalwood form a creamy and woody base that lingers near the skin and is highly elegant. French Avenue Royal Blend Eau de Parfum is ideal if you prefer comfortable, luxurious and contemporary perfumes which seem luxurious but not too loud.

products.title: Paco Rabanne One Million Golden Oud Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne One Million Golden Oud Parfum is a prosperous and bold men's perfume from the house of Rabanne. It launched in 2023 and is a deep, warm scent made with spicy, woody and leathery notes that feel royal and strong. It begins spicy and fresh using saffron, nutmeg, black pepper and bergamot. The middle is a smooth mixture of woody patchouli, gurjan balsam and sandalwood. The base is dark, warm and long lasting, using oud, leather, cedarwood and labdanum.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Matcha Meditation Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Matcha Meditation Eau de Toilette is a calm, clean and comforting unisex fragrance inspired by peaceful tea rituals. It opens fresh and green with soft citrus touches, slowly moving into creamy matcha and gentle white florals. The base feels smooth and cozy with hints of white chocolate, woods and moss.

products.title: Armaf Island Bliss Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Island Bliss Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is soft, sweet, and cheerful which is made for women loving the aroma of fresh tropical fruits. The fragrance opens with wild berries and green notes which are light and playful. Eventually, it becomes creamy with the addition of coconut, orange blossom, and water lily, thus a beach-like setting is created. The dry down has vanilla, tonka bean, and musk that are close to the skin and are warm, smooth, and comforting. This perfume has a relaxing, feminine and casual vibe which is perfect for everyday use.

products.title: Armaf Yum Yum Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Yum Yum Eau de Parfum is a sweet fruity fragrance designed for ladies who adore subtle, playful scents. The top notes are juicy berries, cherry, and orange, which are fresh and fun. Gradually, rose, white flowers, and vanilla reveal their creamy and smooth characters. The bottom line is made up of powdery notes, musk, and amber, which combine to give a gentle warm finish. This perfume is to be considered feminine, comforting and friendly, and so it is ideal for everyday wear.

products.title: Armaf Odyssey Dubai Chocolate Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Dubai Chocolate Eau de Parfum is an opulent, luscious, and sugary fragrance that comes across as a dessert in a container. A warm combination of coffee, pistachio, and praline comes first that is both delicious and inviting. With a very light spiciness of cardamom, next come the cocoa butter and gentle vanilla. The last stage consists of caramel and tonka which making it even smoother, cozier, and more durable. This fragrance feels like hugging, is very contemporary, and is extremely hard to resist.

products.title: Armaf Odyssey Limoni Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Odyssey Limoni Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance that is fresh, pure, and luminous. It is characterized by an intense citrus opening of lemon, orange, mandarin, and bergamot that is very revitalizing and vigorous. Then, the ginger gives a smooth fresh feel to the orange blossom and light marine notes, which are soft in character. The underlying tea, musk, and amber create a composed and uncomplicated fragrance that is ideal for everyday use and warm days.
